The library listing provides song IDs but not durations, and the private playlist endpoint is available. I will retrieve every library playlist, including public favorites, and compare their song counts to 85 minutes after the first successful playback test.

```python
library_playlists = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    playlist_page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=spotify_access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not playlist_page:
        break
    library_playlists.extend(playlist_page)
    page_index += 1
playlist_song_counts = [
    (playlist['title'], len(playlist['song_ids']), apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=playlist['playlist_id'], access_token=spotify_access_token)['songs'])
    for playlist in library_playlists
]
print(playlist_song_counts)
```
